name: import_recording
title: Import recording
description: Create a session bundle from existing recording files (e.g. a Zoom local recording) instead of live capture. At least one of `mic_path` / `system_path` is required (a Zoom recording with everyone in one file is imported as system); `screen_path` optionally adds a video track. All paths must be absolute paths of regular files. With copy=true (default) the files are copied into the bundle; copy=false hard-links them (same volume required) to avoid duplicating large files. `started_at` sets the recording start used for the meeting_id and timeline; when omitted the server derives it from the oldest input file's modification time. `profile` names a saved profile (see list_profiles) whose config, scope, engagement and export_destinations are applied as defaults — explicit `scope` / `engagement` / `config` keys win; when omitted the default profile is applied. With auto_process=true (default) a `process` job is enqueued and its job_id returned; poll it with get_job_status. `request_id` is the client-generated idempotency key: repeating the call returns the original result without importing twice. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: not_found (an input path does not exist), invalid_argument (relative path, not a regular file, neither mic_path nor system_path given, unknown profile, bad config, copy=false across volumes), policy_violation (config selects an engine / provider not allowed by its external_send_policy — nothing is silently substituted), engine_unavailable (config names an engine / provider not registered on this server), internal.

mic_path.description: Absolute path of the microphone (own voice) audio file. At least one of mic_path / system_path is required.

system_path.description: Absolute path of the system / remote-participants audio file. At least one of mic_path / system_path is required.

screen_path.description: Absolute path of the screen video file (optional).

started_at.description: Recording start time (UTC) used for the meeting_id and timeline. Omitted = derived from the oldest input file's modification time.

engagement.description: Optional engagement / project / customer label used for grouping and search.

scope.description: Affiliation scope (confidentiality boundary) of the meeting. Omit for an unscoped meeting (or the profile default).

profile.description: Saved profile name applied as defaults (see list_profiles / set_profile). Omitted = the default profile. Explicit arguments and config keys win.

config.description: Per-meeting processing config overrides. Omitted keys take the profile defaults. Can be changed later with set_meeting_config.

copy.description: true (default) = copy the files into the bundle; false = hard-link them (same volume required).

auto_process.description: Enqueue a `process` job right after importing (default true). Set false to only import; call regenerate later to process.

bundle_path.description: Absolute path of the session bundle directory (<NARUMI_HOME>/meetings/<meeting_id>).

tracks.description: Track name (screen / mic / system) → imported file status (path relative to bundle_path, sha256, size, duration).

job_id.description: Present when auto_process=true: the enqueued `process` job.
